ideas.pitch: A local AI proxy agent specifically designed to detect and block automated prompt injections and malicious API payloads during web exploitation CTF challenges.
ideas.title: CTF-Agent Defense Hardener
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the defense-in-depth and prompt-hardening patterns proven in the BitGN Personal Agent Challenge win to secure web apps against novel offensive vectors.

ideas.pitch: An automated CLI and web tool for rapid multi-layer frequency analysis, spectrogram generation, and hidden payload extraction in audio steganography challenges.
ideas.title: StegoNet Audio Forensics Extractor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the tedious manual work of steganography and digital forensics flags, saving critical minutes during a high-pressure 12-hour national CTF.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight cryptographic puzzle solver optimized for identifying weak block cipher modes, frequency distributions, and custom XOR routines in CTF crypto modules.
ideas.title: CryptoRisc Stream Cipher Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies hard engineering and math automation tailored specifically to the Cryptography track domain of national-level competitions.

ideas.pitch: An automated link-analysis and social footprint visualizer designed to ingest leaked metadata, image EXIF data, and public handles to surface hidden flags in OSINT challenges.
ideas.title: OSINT-Mesh Entity Grapher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the graph intelligence and risk detection approach used by the Bito AML platform, streamlining complex multi-source correlation for judges.

ideas.pitch: A rapid binary visualization plug-in that translates stripped ELF binaries and obfuscated bytecode into interactive control flow graphs for reverse engineering.
ideas.title: BinRev Control Flow Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the hardest domain in the CTF (Reverse Engineering) with a developer tool that drastically accelerates disassembling and patching loops.
